$comment: When and how to use the Dropdown. The component is src/styles/components/dropdown.css, built from Figma "Foundation – UI 2" (Dropdown, node 45:314; component set 45:421). Shown on the Dropdown page and published to public/llms.txt by `npm run tokens`.
intro: Dropdowns let people pick one option from a list without taking up room on the page. They are 24px tall, with an optional 12px icon in front, and come with or without a stroke.

states.label: Borderless
states.usage: No stroke (Figma Stroke=False), for toolbars and dense rows. Add dropdown--borderless.

states.label: Focused
states.usage: Keeps the stroke and adds a soft 1.4px --color-bg-secondary ring — for keyboard and pointer focus and while the list is open. It replaces the default focus outline.

states.label: Disabled
states.usage: Value and chevron in --color-bg-disabled-secondary. Set disabled on the select.

rules: Use <div class="dropdown"> around a <select class="dropdown__select"> and the chevron <svg class="icon dropdown__chevron" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-nav-arrow-down"></use></svg>. Call enhanceDropdown() (src/lib/dropdown.ts) to open the options in a Menu; without it the native list opens.
Use a dropdown to pick one of four or more options. For two or three, show them all; for on/off, use a Switch.
Every dropdown needs a name: a visible <label for> or an aria-label on the select.
Order options so people can scan them (by frequency or alphabetically) and preselect the most common one.
Use dropdown--borderless only where many controls sit together, like toolbars; keep the stroke in forms.
An optional icon before the value hints at what the list holds: add dropdown--icon and <svg class="icon dropdown__icon" aria-hidden="true">. The dropdown sizes icons to 12px.
Disable with the disabled attribute on the select.
